'''Ralf Blobelt Profit Or Die''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ralf Blobelt]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls106.htm Profit Or Die], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228021412/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls106.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
